name: Artefactos de bloques DCT
description: Analiza limites de bloques de Transformada Discreta del Coseno de compresion JPEG.
mechanism: Analiza 8x8 DCT block boundary artefactos and quantization patrones from compresión JPEG. AI images may lack or show inconsistent JPEG artefactos.
parameters: Tamaño de bloque: 8x8, Analysis: block boundary discontinuity, tabla de cuantización estimation
accuracy: Moderada - 65-80%, dependent on image format history
source: Fan and de Queiroz (2003), IEEE ICIP; Bianchi et al. (2012)
useCase: Detecting compresión JPEG history inconsistencias in generado por IA images

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R.L. (2003). Identification of Bitmap Compression History. IEEE ICIP.
Bianchi, T. & Piva, A. (2012). Image Forgery Localization via Block-Grained Analysis. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Direct análisis of JPEG artefactos de compresión
• Can reveal compression history
• Well-understood mathematical basis
• Effective for detecting re-compression
limitations:
• Only applicable to JPEG format
• Non-JPEG AI images won't show DCT artefactos
• Multiple re-compressions complicate análisis
• Low quality images have less reliable patrones
